title: Juicy and Crunchy Foods for Kids! Watermelon, Peas and More with Pip
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is my buddy Kiko the broccoli!
Welcome to Fruity Friends! Today we're meeting five yummy surprises.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Healthy food and healthy habits help us grow big and strong.
Ready? Let's go to the kitchen!

lines: Here's a clue: it's green outside and pink inside! Can you guess?
This is Watermelon! Can you say watermelon?
They are full of water. That's why they're so juicy!
Can you take a big pretend bite? Chomp!
What are the little black dots?
Seeds! Watermelons have lots of them.
One more time, nice and loud: WATERMELON!
Watermelon is a cool treat on a hot day.
Here's a clue: they're little green balls that live in a pod! Can you guess?
This is Peas! Can you say peas?
Open the pod, and there they are, in a row!
Can you count the peas with me? One, two, three, four!
Inside a pod! Like a cozy bed.
One more time, nice and loud: PEAS!
Peas are sweet and green and fun to count.
Here's a clue: it's long and yellow, and you peel it! Can you guess?
This is Banana! Can you say banana?
Peel it down, down, down, and take a bite!
Can you pretend to peel a banana? Peel, peel, peel!
What color is a banana before it's ready?
Green! It turns yellow when it's ready.
One more time, nice and loud: BANANA!
Bananas give you energy to run and play.
Here's a clue: it's big, round and orange, and it grows on a vine! Can you guess?
This is Pumpkin! Can you say pumpkin?
Pumpkins grow on long, curly vines.
Some pumpkins get really, really big!
Can you make yourself round like a pumpkin? Curl up!
One more time, nice and loud: PUMPKIN!
Pumpkin can be soup, or even bread!
Here's a clue: it has lots of colors of food! Can you guess?
This is Rainbow Plate! Can you say rainbow plate?
A rainbow plate has many colors.
Red, orange, yellow, green and blue!
Can you name a color on your plate?
Why do we eat many colors?
Each color helps our body in a different way!
Let's say it together: RAINBOW PLATE!
One more time, nice and loud: RAINBOW PLATE!

outro: Which one was your favorite? Tell a grown-up, and try something new this week!
Bye, friends! See you next time on Fruity Friends!
